Sub: Prompt disposal of pending 7A cases —inclusion of weightage for 7A case disposal
for ranking of RO/SRO in e.samiksha portal.
Sir/Madam,

As you are aware that timely and expeditious disposal of pending 7A cases is of utmost
importance to ensure that the employees working in the establishments to which the EPF & MP Act
applies are extended due benefits in Employees’ Provident Funds Scheme, 1952, Employees’ Pension
Scheme, 1975 and Employees’ Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme, 1976.

2. Though in some cases there may be some complexity leading to delay in finalization of
inquiries, it is to be ensured that majority of cases are disposed off within three months of initiation of
inquiry at the most. The progress of 7A enquiries from 01.04.2016 to 31.07.2016 showing the
opening balance, cases initiated and disposed during the period (Zone-wise) is enclosed for reference

please.

3h In order to ensure that the Assessing Officer gives due importance to this item of work and
Officer In-charges ensure timely disposal of 7A cases by constant review and monitoring, it is
proposed that henceforth the disposal percentage of 7A cases may also be made an indicator of the
ranking given to a RO/SRO in EPFO E.Samiksha. The percentage of 7A enquiries disposed will be the

performance parameter.

4. Accordingly, all OICs are requested to ensure that the 7A cases are properly examined and
reviewed to ensure prompt disposal without any un-necessary and unjustified delays.
(This issues with the approval of ACC-I (Compliance.)
Yours faithfully,
JL:
